description: Builds assets/vendor/three.js: three.js and the addons the 3D page uses, as one plain script (window.THREE), so the site still opens from file:// with nothing to install.

scripts.build: esbuild entry.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --global-name=THREE --legal-comments=inline "--banner:js=// three.js + addons, bundled by tools/three (npm run build) - do not edit." --outfile=../../assets/vendor/three.js
